name: A Visual Sharing Circle on Trauma, Anger, Care and Boundaries
description:
Join us for a Deaf-led visual sharing circle with Charu Narang, founder of DeafWomenToo (DWT). Inspired by warrior garments, this workshop invites Deaf participants to explore shared memories and lived experiences through guided visual activities, including body mapping and creative expression. Together, we will create space for conversations around trauma, anger, healing, and self-expression in a supportive environment.

Participants are welcome to engage at their own comfort level—whether through making, sharing, reflecting, or simply being present.

Please note: This workshop supports personal reflection and self-expression. It is not a therapy session. The session will be conducted in Indian Sign Language (ISL), with interpretation into spoken English.

This session is part of the closing weekend of our exhibition warrior garments and Disability Pride programming 2026.

name: Between the Looms - The Hands that Time Unearthed
Embodied Language: A Deaf-Led Human Library on warrior garments
description:
Join us for a Human Library led by Rashmi Malhotra, founder of India Deaf Queer, as they share their lived experiences and invite conversations around access, identity, and everyday life. Through this session, we will also reflect on the importance of making cultural spaces more inclusive and accessible.

Inspired by MAP's exhibition warrior garments by afra eisma, the session invites participants to reflect on how emotions, identity, and intersectional experiences are carried and expressed. Through Indian Sign Language (ISL), Rashmi creates a space for dialogue, reflection, and exchange with Deaf and queer audiences. You are welcome to join, listen, ask questions, or simply be present.

Please note: This session will be conducted in Indian Sign Language (ISL) with interpretation into spoken English.

This session is happening as part of the closing weekend of our exhibition warrior garments and Disability Pride programming 2026
